title: The Vault of Fading Crowns
story: Deep in the Snowlock Vault, Pellucid the Frost Auditor freezes a village's rescue fund and takes a bite out of it every hour. The fund began at 800 gold crowns; each hour Pellucid drains 25% of whatever is left, and the villagers need at least 300 crowns to buy firewood before nightfall. Mr 6 studies the frosted ledger and counts the hours.
question: How many crowns are left after 3 hours of Pellucid's draining?
solution: Draining 25% leaves 75%, so after 1 hour: 800 × 0.75 = 600 crowns.
praise: Taking 75% each hour was exactly the right strategy — the drain just had to be applied one more time.
hint: If 25% is taken away, what percent stays? Apply that to the new total each hour, not to 800 every time.
victory: Mr 6 announced the exact leftover down to the half-crown, and Pellucid's frosty ledger cracked in embarrassment. The villagers bought firewood with 37.5 crowns to spare — and one very warm pie.
imagePrompt: A pale translucent auditor-spirit hovering over a frost-covered vault of glittering gold coins while a small knight numeral 6 points at an icy ledger, cold blue light and drifting snow.
